tn_openelections_2008.transcription: none (parsed CSV); some years summed from precinct files
tn_openelections_2008.license: The openelections-data-tn repository has no license file (checked 2026-09-23 via the GitHub API); OpenElections states 'The data is and will remain free to anyone' (openelections.net/about); underlying counts are public records
tn_openelections_2008.notes: Known limits are in data_corrections_log.csv where found

tx_sos_web_2008.publisher: Texas Secretary of State, Elections Division
tx_sos_web_2008.document: Historical Elections - Official Results, 2008 general election, U.S. Representative by county (Nov special-election ballots and December runoffs for court-redrawn districts in 1996 and 2006)
tx_sos_web_2008.transcription: parsed HTML; county rows and ALL COUNTIES rows tie (02r_house_tx_sos.R)
tx_sos_web_2008.license: No license or terms stated on the pages/files used; official public record published by the state agency. Reuse terms not confirmed. Terms check 2026-09-23: sos.state.tx.us disclaimer and link policy: no general copyright claim or reuse license (link policy notes some material may be protected IP); Open Records Policy page not retrievable.

ut_sos_file_2008.document: Historical election results 2008, U.S. Representative by county
ut_sos_file_2008.license: No license or terms stated on the pages/files used; official public record published by the state agency. Reuse terms not confirmed. Terms check 2026-09-23: utah.gov disclaimer: 'Anyone may view, copy, or distribute information found within these web pages ... for personal or informational use without owing an obligation to the State if the documents are not modified in any respect'; footer 'Copyright State of Utah'. Ambiguous for derived tables.

vt_sos_web_2008.publisher: Vermont Secretary of State, VT Elections Database
vt_sos_web_2008.document: 2008 general election, U.S. House, one Results CSV (town/city rows)
vt_sos_web_2008.locator: https://electionarchive.vermont.gov/ (contest CSV via /api/download_contest/<contest id>_table.csv, tenant vt -- same Elstats platform as Virginia historical.elections.virginia.gov)
vt_sos_web_2008.obtained: downloaded (site's own public search and download endpoints)
vt_sos_web_2008.transcription: parsed CSV; town/city rows summed to county via a Wikipedia-sourced town->county crosswalk (Vermont has no county government); Vermont is a single at-large seat, no district split
vt_sos_web_2008.license: No license or terms stated on the pages/files used; official public record published by the state agency. Reuse terms not confirmed. Terms check 2026-09-23: electionarchive.vermont.gov (Elstats platform) has no terms; sos.vermont.gov footer says 'All rights reserved'; no vendor terms found.
vt_sos_web_2008.notes: town-level sum vs the site's own printed State total differs by <0.5% of total votes in 1990 and 2002 (data_corrections_log.csv); Sherburne town renamed Killington in 1999, source uses old name through 2000

va_sos_web_2008.publisher: Virginia Department of Elections, Historical Elections Database
va_sos_web_2008.document: 2008 general election, U.S. House, one Results CSV per congressional district (locality rows)
va_sos_web_2008.obtained: downloaded (site's own public search and download endpoints)
va_sos_web_2008.transcription: parsed CSV; locality rows tie to district totals (02r_house_va.R)
va_sos_web_2008.license: No license or terms stated on the pages/files used; official public record published by the state agency. Reuse terms not confirmed. Terms check 2026-09-23: historical.elections.virginia.gov (Elstats platform) has no terms; the Department of Elections footer says 'All rights reserved'; the privacy policy covers only FOIA and data collection.
va_sos_web_2008.notes: the database labels the cities of Richmond and Franklin as counties in most years (resolved by geography)

wa_sos_file_2008.publisher: Washington Secretary of State (Elections: 2008 General Election data download)
wa_sos_file_2008.document: 2008 General Election data downloads: 2008 - 2008GenCumResultsallCounties.xls (county x congressional district x candidate) and 2008GenAllContestsFinal.xls (district totals, party labels); 2010 - county precinct files (one per county, five layouts)
wa_sos_file_2008.transcription: parsed workbook/CSV/TXT rows summed to county x district x candidate; 2008 county sums equal the printed district totals; 2010 district totals equal the FEC official results in all 9 districts (01eu_house_county_washington_sos.R, 01ew_washington_2010_sos_precinct.R)
wa_sos_file_2008.license: sos.wa.gov privacy policy page: 'This is a public domain web site. Most of the information on this site is not copyrighted. You may use, share or copy such information appearing on this site' and asks that credit be given to the Office of the Secretary of State. Terms check 2026-09-23.
wa_sos_file_2008.notes: Top-two general elections: two candidates per district (plus the CD7 independent in 2010); 2010 party labels from a fixed table (SOS files carry none); write-ins excluded; Pierce precinct cells suppressed for privacy are covered by using the printed Contest Total

wv_state_publication_2008.document: West Virginia Blue Book (odd-year volume covering the prior even year), Section 8 (Political), U.S. House of Representatives, General Election 2008 returns
wv_state_publication_2008.locator: local copy: R/data/county_house_files/WVS_Bluebook_{plus1}.pdf (e.g. the 1990 general is in the 1991-dated volume; 2010's is in the 2011-dated volume)
wv_state_publication_2008.obtained: user-supplied downloads of the WV Blue Book volumes covering each general election year
wv_state_publication_2008.transcription: hand-transcribed from pdftotext -layout output; every district's county column verified against the book's own printed TOTAL row; one OCR-garbled digit (2010 Braxton) and one OCR-garbled county name (1996 CD3's last county) resolved via the total-row check
wv_state_publication_2008.license: State government publication; license unknown Terms check 2026-09-23: wvlegislature.gov terms are a warranty/accuracy disclaimer with a copyright footer; the Blue Book's own copyright page was not checked.
wv_state_publication_2008.notes: Closes the WV House 1990/1992/1994/1996/1998 source_not_found gap (OpenElections' WV repo starts at 2000) and extends 2008 from 48->55 and 2010 from 31->55 counties (OpenElections' 2008/2010 precinct files are themselves incomplete for many counties, larger than the TOTALS-row bug fixed in 01az -- see data_corrections_log.csv). WV House is now complete, zero gaps, 1990-2024.
